ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

mega-menu.anchor-width-content: This panel matches the header width.
mega-menu.appearance-note: Underline is the default. Text uses muted text until its trigger is active.
mega-menu.basic-note: Hover, focus, or click a trigger. A group keeps only one panel open at a time.
mega-menu.controlled-content: This panel is bound with two-way open state.
mega-menu.controlled-note: The open model supports programmatic control in addition to trigger interaction.
mega-menu.description: A navigation overlay for groups of related destinations and editorial content.

examples.note: Start with the full navigation bar, then explore appearance, width, and keyboard below.

mega-menu.feature-description: Compose rich panels without imposing menu semantics on links.
mega-menu.hover-delay-note: This trigger waits 400 ms before opening and closing on pointer movement.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

mega-menu.keyboard-note: Focus a trigger and use ArrowLeft and ArrowRight to move between triggers, ArrowDown to open and enter the panel, Home and End to jump, Escape to close.
mega-menu.persistent-content: Click the trigger again or click outside to close.
mega-menu.persistent-note: Clicking this trigger keeps its panel open after the pointer leaves.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

mega-menu.responsive-note: Mega Menu is a desktop pattern. Below your breakpoint, replace the trigger bar with a drawer or menu instead of squeezing panels.
mega-menu.title: Mega Menu
mega-menu.trigger-width-content: This panel matches the trigger width.
mega-menu.width-note: Choose a panel aligned to the trigger, its anchor, or the viewport.
